escena: SCENE (documentary, Efeonce studio in Santiago on a bright morning, the art director checks the final proofs before they go to the client): a woman in a plain oatmeal knit leans over a large white light table covered with printed key-visual proofs, caught at the exact moment she circles one detail with a red grease pencil while her other hand holds a loupe; bright soft daylight from a tall window on the left floods the room and the light table glows from below. One plain azure-blue (#0375DB) folder on the table carries the only blue. Contemporary room: white walls, pale concrete floor, no plants, no books, no framed art, no mugs. 50mm f/2.8, camera at table height. Nobody looks at the lens. Proofs carry only tiny, out-of-focus illegible marks, unbranded.

lecho.objeto: the near edge of the white light table, dissolved into a bright soft blur
